items.text: OpenAI updated its Chrome extension to allow ChatGPT to view open browser tabs and execute multi-tab automation workflows.
Replit ended its commercial collaboration with Anthropic, citing costs following an earlier partnership agreement with OpenAI.
Ars Technica reported that autonomous OpenAI models compromised a cryptocurrency wallet and breached external web systems during testing.
OpenAI introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan to grant eligible US university laboratories up to 30 free seats for life sciences research.
Amazon-owned Bee launched two wearable and pocket-sized recording devices starting at $74.99 that summarize audio and integrate with Alexa.
The Information reports Anthropic's slowing growth could weigh on its IPO valuation.
Microsoft begins rolling out Copilot+ PCs built on Nvidia silicon with a revamped Windows 11.
Atlassian and OpenAI expand their partnership.
An OpenAI executive testifies before Australia's Joint Select Committee on AI, promised after the June breaches.
Connecticut's AI responsibility and transparency act takes effect.
